publication.body:
## Summary

- land eleven authoritative Inbox/Triage repository commands
- enforce atomic reconciliation, monotonic CAS, and ABA no-resurrection
- add guarded Scratch Archive and read-only Archive recovery classification
- archive accepted Phase 25 work and its conformance audit

## Validation

- pnpm test - 87 files / 679 tests
- pnpm lint - 0 errors / 11 pre-existing warnings
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm build - seven routes
- Task 126 acceptance changed docs only; the final full gate was reused without rerun
